about: The states an idea for a tool can be in, and every move between them with the component or person that makes it. Pages draw the lifecycle from this file; scripts/check-architecture.mjs checks it against the registry.

states.label: Discovered
states.detail: A candidate address or a request has been captured.

states.label: Recorded
states.detail: On the list, waiting to be looked at.

states.label: Observed
states.detail: What it does, and the rule it cites, are written down.

states.label: Needs a sub-tool
states.detail: Waiting for a rule to be written for this case.

states.label: Screened out
states.detail: Failed a gate. The reason is recorded.

states.label: Scored
states.detail: Rated on the 100-point rubric, with a recommendation.

states.label: Parked
states.detail: Held, with the thing blocking it named.

states.label: Approved
states.detail: To be built. The credit note and the specification are written.

states.label: Live
states.detail: In the catalog and being watched.

states.label: Rejected
states.detail: Declined. The reason and the score are kept.

states.label: Linked
states.detail: The catalog points to the existing tool instead of rebuilding it.

states.label: Merged
states.detail: Folded into another tool as a feature.

states.label: Retired
states.detail: Taken out of use, with a note of why.

transitions.when: it is given an identifier and is not a duplicate
the address is dead or a duplicate
its public pages have been read
the source is in a form intake has no rule for
it fails any knockout gate
it passes all five gates
a worker has no rule for what it found
the rule ships and the item is run again
the owner overrides, or the idea is reshaped
the owner chooses to build
a free, private tool already does the job
it belongs inside another tool
it is worth doing but blocked
it falls below the threshold
the blocker clears
its repository is generated
there is no profile for that kind of tool
it passes all five listing conditions
the rule turns out to be unclear
the rule it rests on changes
the rule is repealed or replaced
that tool breaks or starts tracking users
